20173.long_desc: Our 55inch LCD Arcade Monitor supporting 15khz, 25khz, 31khz and update to 1080p and is the the perfect LCD panel for your arcade machine. Low response time, great colour depth, audio out and with full mounting frame, the Arcooda arcade monitor supports RGB, VGA and HDMI and has been specially designed to support CGA, EGA and VGA arcade game board resolutions. The Arcooda 55 inch LCD arcade monitor has designed for the arcade industry to suite a wide range of uses, video resolutions, custom arcade cabinets, or monitor replacements for Sega, Namco, and Raw Thrills arcade machines. It offers a number of features that include; - supports VGA & HDMI input, and RGB via the Arcooda RGB board that allows you to also adjust colours via potentiometers. - video input support offers 15khz, 25khz, 31khz, and up to 1080p at low monitor lag - many monitor adjustments that include auto-picture, fine tuning options and viewing ratios (keep the 4:3 ratio or display at 16:9). - extendable monitor adjustment board. Mount in the monitor frame, or, use the extension to mount at the front of your arcade machine. The Arcooda 55" LCD Arcade Monitor is ready for all your arcade action and has been specially designed for arcade machines without the need for video converters. With full black metal case, mounting brackets and separate monitor adjustment board, installation is super easy and little technical skill needed. Simply plug in your game boards and cables and you're ready to go! RoHs certified, this premium LCD arcade monitor comes with 12 months warranty. V32 Firmware - a wider range of 15khz arcade game board titles supported including 50,54 60 and 70Hz titles such as NBA Jam / Mortal Kombat, supports 24-25khz game titles such as Daytona USA & Virtua Striker, and all 31khz titles up to 1080P. - offers 7 menu languages, updated auto picture functions, quicker transition between video signal resolutions, and more. Dual Mounting Options - 4 cabinet mounting angle brackets to suit timber or steel cabinets - Horizontal and vertical mounting via M6 - VESA and 200mmx400mm and 400mmx400mm mounting via M6 Audio Output Support - connect your HDMI input into the Arcooda 55inch arcade LCD monitor, then connect your 3.5mm audio jack out of the monitor into your audio system. Breakout OSD Menu Board (included) - access the monitor menu via the regular monitor buttons on the metal cabinet, or, use the 160cm extension cable to mount a secondary monitor adjustment board anywhere in your cabinet. No longer do you need a second person to help adjust the monitor settings.
